title: Shared Calendar Protected Date-Night Rate
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sharedcalendar:event
| search event_type="date_night"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(status="kept")) as successful by _time month
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for protected date nights by month.
value: A protected date-night rate shows whether good intentions are surviving the real calendar.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for protected date nights events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for protected date nights by month.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how often protected date nights works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
